main.description: For the app's moderators: a reported activity or comment as the AppView indexed it, at any visibility, with photo links signed for the moderator. Requires service auth from a member of the app's labeler team with the moderator or admin role. A subject that isn't Public is answered only while the labeler has an open report or review on it or its author, and each such answer is audit-logged.

visibility.description: Who may see the subject: an activity's tier, or the narrower of a comment's audience and its activity's.

activity.description: The subject, when it's an activity.

comment.description: The subject, when it's a comment.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such subject, or it isn't Public and isn't under review.

errors.name: LabelerUnavailable
errors.description: The labeler couldn't be asked about the caller's role or the subject's review.
